runtimeArgs: const http=require('http'),fs=require('fs'),p=require('path');const T={'.html':'text/html; charset=utf-8','.js':'text/javascript; charset=utf-8','.css':'text/css; charset=utf-8','.json':'application/json','.png':'image/png','.jpg':'image/jpeg','.webp':'image/webp','.svg':'image/svg+xml'};http.createServer((q,s)=>{let f=decodeURIComponent(q.url.split('?')[0]);if(f==='/')f='/index.html';const t=p.join(process.cwd(),f);fs.readFile(t,(e,d)=>{if(e){s.writeHead(404);s.end('404');return}s.writeHead(200,{'Content-Type':T[p.extname(t)]||'application/octet-stream','Cache-Control':'no-store'});s.end(d)})}).listen(8834,()=>console.log('dev server on http://localhost:8834'));
